email.tooFew: Email orders are for {{minPizzas}} pizzas or more. This order has {{count}}: have our AI call instead.

email.limitHelp: Never shown to {{shop}}. Up to {{max}}. If their total with tax is higher, we ask you first.

email.switchToCallIntro: Pickup sooner, or a smaller order? Our AI can phone {{shop}} now.
email.switchToEmailIntro: A big order a day or more ahead? We can email {{shop}} the order instead of calling.

status.approveOtherTitle: Waiting for approval of the email to {{shop}}

status.sendingDetail: Approved. We're emailing the order to {{shop}} now. Nothing is ordered until they confirm.
status.scheduledDetail: We send order emails during the shop's hours. It goes out {{time}}. Nothing is ordered until they confirm.
status.waitingDetail: We emailed {{shop}} the order {{sent}}. They have until {{replyBy}} to confirm their total. Nothing is ordered until they do; we'll email you when they answer.
status.waitingDetailNoTimes: We emailed {{shop}} the order. Nothing is ordered until they confirm their total; we'll email you when they answer.
status.waitingCaution: Please don't order elsewhere while you wait.
status.priceDetail: That's over your {{limit}} limit. Approve or decline with the one-tap link in the email we sent you. {{shop}} won't start the order until you approve.
status.priceDetailOther: That's over the {{limit}} limit. The host who placed it approves or declines from their email. {{shop}} won't start the order until they approve.
status.priceBy: Answer by {{time}}, or the order is canceled and {{shop}} is told not to make it.
status.confirmedPay: Pay at pickup, then upload the real receipt as usual (the reminder line in your Receipts list is not a receipt).
status.declinedDetail: Nothing was ordered. Pick another pizzeria, or call {{shop}} yourself.
status.withdrawnTitle: Canceled: {{shop}} may still have the order
status.mayExistUnknown: We can't tell whether {{shop}} has this order. Check with them before you order elsewhere.
status.stepCall: Call {{shop}} and ask whether they have the order we emailed them for pickup {{time}}.
status.stepIfYes: If they do: pick it up and pay as usual, then upload the receipt.
status.stepIfNo: If they don't: release it below so it stops counting against your budget.
status.stepIfNoNoRelease: If they don't: you can order again.
status.caution: Please don't order again until you've checked with them.
status.stepCallNoTime: Call {{shop}} and ask whether they have the order we emailed them.
